standfirst: Human adenovirus F and its simian relatives carry two or more fiber genes and are kept apart from the one-fiber mastadenoviruses. Core calling is high; most poor genomes here are partial or carry interrupted genes, which the checked examples confirm is the sequence and not the profile.

modules.Mastadenovirus_MultiFiber: Mastadenoviruses that carry more than one fiber gene: human adenovirus F (types 40 and 41) and the simian and rhesus adenoviruses whose fiber census places them here.

gaps: Features not modelled and known limits are listed in section 07 of the coverage audit and in BUILD_NOTES.md.
